truefeedback.text:
Here is a worked solution:

Since all the angles in the triangles \(ABC\) and \(ADE\) are the same, they are similar.

Therefore, for some constant \(k>1:\)

\(BC=kDE=3k\)
\(AB=kAD=4k\)
\(AC=kAE=5k\)

Subtracting the lengths of \(AD\) and \(AE\) to get \(BD\) and \(CE\) respectively gives:

\(BC=3k,\) \(AB=4k-4\) and \(AC=5k-5\)


For example, taking \(k=2\) gives \(BC=6cm,\) \(AB=4cm\) and \(AC=5cm\).
Your first set of lengths is correct.

Your first set of lengths is a correct set of values for \(AB, BC\) and \(AC\).
However, you have forgotten to subtract the lengths of \(AD\) and \(AE\) to get \(BD\) and \(CE\) respectively.

For your first set of lengths, the values for \({@if (ans2+4)/4=(ans3+5)/5 then "BD" else "BC"@}\) and \({@if ans1/3=(ans3+5)/5 then "CE" else "BD"@}\) are correct.
However \({@if ans1/3=(ans2+4)/4 then "CE" else if ans1/3=(ans3+5)/5 then "BD" else "BC"@}\) is not.

From your answers:

\(\frac{BC}{DE} = \frac{{@ans1@}}{3} = {@ans1/3@}\)

\(\frac{AB}{AD} = \frac{{@ans2@}+4}{4} = {@(ans2+4)/4@}\)

\(\frac{AC}{AE} = \frac{{@ans3@}+5}{5} = {@(ans3+5)/5@}\)

However, since the triangles are similar, all of these ratios should be the same.

To achieve this, you could change \({@if ans1/3=(ans2+4)/4 then "CE" else if ans1/3=(ans3+5)/5 then "BD" else "BC"@}\) to \({@if ans1/3=(ans2+4)/4 then (5*ans1/3)-5 else if ans1/3=(ans3+5)/5 then (4*ans1/3)-4 else (3*(ans2+4)/4)-3@}cm\).

For your first set of lengths, you have attempted to find values for \(AB, BC\) and \(AC\).
However, you have forgotten to subtract the lengths of \(AD\) and \(AE\) to get \(BD\) and \(CE\) respectively.

Also, if \({@if ans2/4=ans3/5 then "AB" else "BC"@} = {@if ans2/4=ans3/5 then ans2 else ans1@}cm\) and \({@if ans1/3=ans2/4 then "AB" else "AC"@} = {@if ans1/3=ans2/4 then ans2 else ans3@}cm\), then:

\(\frac{BC}{DE} = \frac{{@ans1@}}{3} = {@ans1/3@}\)

\(\frac{AB}{AD} = \frac{{@ans2@}}{4} = {@ans2/4@}\)

\(\frac{AC}{AE} = \frac{{@ans3@}}{5} = {@ans3/5@}\)

However, since the triangles are similar, all of these ratios should be the same.

To achieve this, \({@if ans1/3=ans2/4 then "AC" else if ans1/3=ans3/5 then "AB" else "BC"@}\) should be \({@if ans1/3=ans2/4 then 5*ans1/3 else if ans1/3=ans3/5 then 4*ans1/3 else 3*ans2/4@}cm\).
